text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Sensei. Regarding the revisions to the 
idea from the other day, 
could we add a gradation to this section 
here? Also, for the shape—

text_block_list.name: Japanese Sweet Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
I see—that sounds interesting. 
Hand-shaped pieces are the crown jewels of 
wagashi, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sensei! I have forged a brand new idea! 
Three whole notebooks' worth, brainstormed 
through a relentless cycle of 
Bakushin-sleeping and Bakushin-waking!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'll help with the prototyping too! 
My hands are free right now!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Welgome! ...Welcome! 
Haaah, thinkin' of myself as the face of 
the shop is makin' me so nervous...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Step by step, let us steadily master each 
task... 
You have already gotten the hang of 
operating the cash register, after all...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yuki-chan! I got the flyers printed!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ticket-san! 
Let's split up the areas and start handin' 
'em out together, then!

text_block_list.name: Woman Returning from Shopping
text_block_list.text:
A wagashi showdown? 
Huh, with brand-new sweets made for 
Valentine's Day?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep! There are stylish sweets, 
Bakushin-style sweets, and more! 
There's a whole bunch of unique Valentine 
wagashi! You've gotta come check it out!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-sa~n! I finished handin' out my 
batch! 
If you've still got extras, pass some 
over!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
—Ooooh! So cool! You look amazin', 
Cafe-san! 
Is this what they call a blend of Japanese 
and Western styles!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...You make for... a splendid "poster 
girl" yourself, Yukino-san.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Aw shucks, I'm almost embarrassed. Just 
'cause I'm on customer service duty, 
I ended up gettin' my outfit made before 
everyone else...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Tomorrow is finally the day. The 
wagashi showdown. 
The sweets designed by Flight-san and 
Bakushin O-san... will finally be lined up 
in the storefront.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gettin' so excited! I really hope lots 
of customers show up, though... 
Oh, that's right! Since I'm all dressed 
up, I should go hand out more flyers—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............ 
...I have been wondering about something.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Lately... serving customers, working the 
register... passing out flyers. 
—And finding spare moments to help 
Bakushin O and the others.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Even at the dorm... staying up late 
brainstorming ideas to promote the shop. 
...Aren't you taking on... a bit too 
much...?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That ain't true at all! I'm the one who 
started this whole thing in the first 
place. 
So of course I gotta work the hardest!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I promised I'd do whatever it takes for 
this shop! 
It's only natural! Now, I'm off to hand 
out the last batch of flyers!

text_block_list.name: Customer Who Saw the Flyer
text_block_list.text:
...Is this it? The shop mentioned on the 
flyer. 
I wonder what kind of Valentine's wagashi 
they have?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Customer
text_block_list.text:
A wagashi showdown... is it? 
Kukuku... How intriguing. Let us see what 
you are made of.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you all for waiting!! 
We are now officially open for business!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino & Cafe
text_block_list.text:
W-Welcome, everyone! 
Our brand-new Valentine's wagashi are now 
on sale starting today!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A dazzling array of Valentine's wagashi 
adorns the display case! 
Masterpieces showcasing the innovative 
ideas of two Umamusume! But...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Which one will reign supreme as the number 
one wagashi?! Whose 
sweets will capture the customers' 
hearts?! The Wagashi Showdown—begins now!!

text_block_list.name: Customer Who Saw the Flyer
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world is this sweet...?! A 
flower-shaped nerikiri—with 
a gorgeous patterned gradation from brown 
to red!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ That one is mine! It's a nerikiri 
blended with chocolate, 
crafted in the shape of a rose—symbolizing 
"love" in the language of flowers!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Named after another Japanese term for 
rose, I present: "Gekki"! 
Please, enjoy♪

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, a purchase for Flight's confection! 
Its sophisticated design has 
captivated the customer's heart! Is 
Bakushin O already in a pinch?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! As expected of Flight-san! 
However, there is no need to worry!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A match for me in both racing and 
academics, Fashion Committee Chair 
Flight-san! Her exemplary standing is 
among the academy's finest... however!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I am the All-Around Class Rep!! And right 
now, I shall prove that I am 
the ultimate Class Rep—an exemplar across 
all worlds!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Behold, my Bakushin Confections— 
"Baku," "Shin," "Baku," "Shin," "Baku," 
and "Shin"!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Customer
text_block_list.text:
What are these? That is quite a large 
number of mochi sweets... 
Furthermore, they all seem to have 
interlocking puzzle-like notches.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fuhfuhfu. 
You see... you do this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin Docking! Wagashi Super 
Combination!! 
SAKURA MOCHIMOCHI O!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-What in the world is that?! 
The sweets—have combined?!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Customer
text_block_list.text:
Munch, munch... T-This is... By combining 
different flavors, 
the taste changes endlessly... What kind 
of wagashi is this...?!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Customer
text_block_list.text:
—C-Could it be?! Two becoming one = a 
match made in heaven?! 
You're telling me it even perfectly nails 
the Valentine's theme...?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Customers
text_block_list.text:
“Ooooh...!” 
“So that's what it means...”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! I don't really understand, but 
such is the duty of a Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...It's utterly chaotic, yet she somehow 
hits every key point. 
That's Bakushin-chan for you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(Finding that "radiance," thinking it 
through, and giving it form. That's my 
way. 
Yet... she doesn't think. She simply 
dashes along the shortest path—straight 
into the answer.)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
(However... delicately layering meaning 
and weaving it into a single theme. 
That is the realm of design. And this 
domain... belongs to me!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how about this wagashi? 
It's called "Tenjikuaoi"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I shall follow up in rapid succession as 
well! 
"Baku"! "Shin"! "Baku"! "Shin"! "Baku"! 
"Shin"!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Sparks are flying between their 
competing prides! 
It's a full-blown Wagashi Rush!! Who will 
seize victory in this battle?!

text_block_list.name: Woman Returning from Shopping
text_block_list.text:
—Excuse me! 
Can I get three of the "Gekki," please!

text_block_list.name: Old Woman in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
I think I'll buy this "Baku" and "Shin" 
combo for my grandkid.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, right away! Three "Gekki," and 
then, Bakushin Bakushin...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yuki-chan! They said we're almost out of 
ingredients! 
I'll sprint over and buy some!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! Ticket-san, you're in charge of 
hyping up the crowd, so I'll go! 
Oh, right, I'll take some flyers with me 
while I'm at it—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I will go.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? C-Cafe-san? 
But—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I will hand out order sheets to the 
customers waiting in line. 
...And I can distribute the flyers along 
the way as well.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Cafe-san.
